name: Facial Aging Consistency
description: Analyzes consistency of aging features (wrinkles, spots, skin texture) across face — AI often has inconsistent aging.
mechanism:
이 방법은 checks facial aging consistency 딥페이크 탐지를 위해:

1. **AgeMarker감지**: Facial aging markers are detected 프레임당: wrinkle density and depth (crow's feet, forehead lines, nasolabial folds), skin texture changes (reduced elasticity, increased roughness), skin laxity (jowling, under-eye bags), and pigmentation changes.

2. **Age일관성검증**: All aging markers should indicate a 일관된 age range. 본 방법은 checks whether wrinkle density, skin texture, and facial volume are mutually 일관된. Deepfakes that swap faces between individuals of different ages may produce 일관성 없는 aging cues — young skin texture with deep wrinkles, or aged skin with juvenile facial volume.

3. **RegionalAge일관성**: Different facial regions should show coherent aging. 본 방법은 verifies that forehead wrinkles, crow's feet, nasolabial folds, and neck skin show the same approximate aging level. AI generation may produce faces with regionally 일관성 없는 aging — perfectly smooth forehead with aged eye areas.

4. **시간적Aging안정성**: Aging markers are static structures that don't change between video frames. Wrinkle positions and depths should remain constant. 본 방법은 tracks aging markers 프레임 전반에 걸쳐 — deepfake generators may produce temporally 일관성 없는 wrinkles that appear, disappear, or shift position as the face is re-generated each frame.

5. **Context-얼굴Age매칭**: If the surrounding context provides age cues (body, hands, clothing style), 본 방법은 checks whether the face age is 일관된 with these contextual indicators. Face-swapping an young face onto an older body creates detectable age inconsistencies between face and body.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
